name: Meta-DOB
summary: Meta-DOB, also known as 5-bromo-2,4-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the psychedelic drug DOB. It is a positional isomer of DOB in which the bromine atom at the 4 position and the methoxy group at the 5 position have been interchanged.

fact.en: Meta-DOB has exactly the same atoms as DOB, but the bromine and one methoxy group have swapped places on the ring. Shulgin described it in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: Meta-DOB 的原子與 DOB 完全相同，只是溴原子與一個甲氧基在環上交換了位置。舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: Meta-DOB 的原子与 DOB 完全相同，只是溴原子与一个甲氧基在环上交换了位置。舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述过它。
